solution: To find the pattern, look at the differences between consecutive terms: $50 - 45 = 5$, $55 - 50 = 5$, $60 - 55 = 5$, $65 - 60 = 5$.
The pattern is to add 5 each time. To find the sixth power chamber, add 5 to the fifth power chamber: $65 + 5 = 70$
Therefore, Zenitsu will put 70 thunder crystals in the sixth power chamber.
